			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_v_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_v_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_v_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 172
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_v_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m172_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m172_capacity_hours_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_decision_rule value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_decision_rule value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_policy_debt_due_days value = 180 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_object_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_object_state value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_rule_frozen_before_vote value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_decision_rule_code value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_veto_reason_required value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_expert_weight_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m169_expert_weight }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_external_weight_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m169_external_weight }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_panel_weight_check value = var:zg361_pp_m172_expert_weight_consumed }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_panel_weight_check add = var:zg361_pp_m172_external_weight_consumed }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_active_panel_revision_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_revision }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_active_panel_count_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_count }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_active_panel_1_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_active_panel_2_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_active_panel_3_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m171_active_panel_3 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_decision_rule_code value = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_rule_drift_debt value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m172_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m172_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m172_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_v_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_v_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_v_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_v_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_v_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_v_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m172_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m172_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m172_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m172_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m172_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m172_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m172_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m172_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m172_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m172_decision_rule
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_v_revision }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m172_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m172_decision_rule } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition value = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition add = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_partition = var:zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_v_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_v_try_advance_02_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m172_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m172_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m172_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_v_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_v_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_v_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_audit_1_expected_state value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m172_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m172_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2172 days = 180 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2172 days = 30 } }
	}
}
